text:
Casey (Support): Escalating to CS — multiple trials (Alder, Meridian) reporting "activation_pending" and 500s on /v1/provision. Alder renewal in ~48h, marking as high risk.

Priya (CS): Ack. Paste sample errors + request IDs and I'll draft a calm comms + flag CRM.

Casey (Support): Logs: 
```
2026-06-05T11:04:12Z ERROR provisioner: failed to allocate quota -> 500 req=req_z7a tenant=alder
2026-06-05T11:04:15Z ERROR cache: lease timeout req=req_z7b tenant=meridian
```
Customers see spinner and retries.

eng-oncall-bot: Root cause: provisioning worker OOM after recent deploy. Mitigation: rolling patch + worker restart. ETA ~25m. Monitoring.

Priya (CS): Ok. Draft outreach: offer 5-day extension + 15-min troubleshooting session; transparent note and follow-up when fixed. Anyone able to manual-provision VIPs?

Jaime (Support): Admin manual-provision works for some tenants: Admin UI -> Tenants -> Actions -> Manual provision. CLI: ./admin provision --tenant <id> --force. Use for Alder if needed.

Priya (CS): Action items: 1) Priya send outreach to Alder + Meridian now (cc Sales); 2) Jaime/manual-provision Alder if they confirm; 3) eng post final recovery; 4) Lena (Sales) hold renewal call until we confirm.

Lena (Sales): Please cc me on Alder outreach and don't commit credits without looping me.

eng-oncall-bot: Patch applied; worker restart completed. Provisioning success back to ~99% over 10m. Closing monitoring window but will alert on regressions.
